title: Concept of Repeated Expressions
theory:
 When the same singular noun is repeated and connected by prepositions such as "after, by, to, over,
     etc.", the subject is treated as singular. Therefore, the verb used with it must also be singular.
    X face to face                X hand in hand                  X side by side                 X drop by drop
    X door to door                X word for word                 X city after city              X one by one
    X ship after ship             X town after town               X row upon Row                 X layer by layer
    X step by step                X day by day                    X line by line                 X mile by mile
    X hand to hand                X year after year               X page after page              X page upon page
    X back to back                X layer upon layer              X row after row                X letter for letter
